name: Luma Reframe
description: Change the aspect ratio of any video (up to 30 seconds long or 100mb). You can use this model to change a landscape 16:9 video to a tall 9:16 one, or expand to a square, and so on.

action.description: Change the aspect ratio of any video (up to 30 seconds long or 100mb). You can use this model to change a landscape 16:9 video to a tall 9:16 one, or expand to a square, and so on.
action.name: luma/reframe-video

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the reframed video
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

grid_position_x.description: The x position of the video in the grid, in pixels. Controls horizontal positioning of the source video within the target output dimensions.
grid_position_x.title: Grid Position X

grid_position_y.description: The y position of the video in the grid, in pixels. Controls vertical positioning of the source video within the target output dimensions.
grid_position_y.title: Grid Position Y

prompt.description: A prompt to guide the reframing generation.
prompt.title: Prompt

video_url.description: URL of the video to reframe. Maximum video size is 100mb. Maximum video duration is 30 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url

x_end.description: The x end of the crop bounds, in pixels. Defines the right boundary where your source video will be placed in the output frame. The distance between x_start and x_end determines the resized width of your content.
x_end.title: X End

x_start.description: The x start of the crop bounds, in pixels. Defines the left boundary where your source video will be placed in the output frame. The distance between x_start and x_end determines the resized width of your content.
x_start.title: X Start

y_end.description: The y end of the crop bounds, in pixels. Defines the bottom boundary where your source video will be placed in the output frame. The distance between y_start and y_end determines the resized height of your content.
y_end.title: Y End

y_start.description: The y start of the crop bounds, in pixels. Defines the top boundary where your source video will be placed in the output frame. The distance between y_start and y_end determines the resized height of your content.
y_start.title: Y Start
